FIRST INFORMATION REPORT (Under Section 154 Cr.P.C.)
FIR No: 00492/2026 | Date & Time: 01-Sept-2026, 02:45 AM | Police Station: Special Crime Branch, Cyber Park

1. INCIDENT DETAILS:
On 01-Sept-2026 at approximately 02:15 AM, an emergency security trip alarm was triggered at the Tech Vault Facility located in Cyber Park, Block B4. First responding police units led by Inspector Vikram Sharma arrived at the scene at 02:28 AM. Upon entering server room B4, whistleblower and senior sysadmin Rajesh Kumar was discovered deceased near server rack 12 with a single gunshot entry wound to the upper chest.

2. SUSPECT & CCTV EVIDENCE:
Preliminary inspection of internal CCTV footage (Camera Feed #B4-09) recorded a masked male intruder wearing a dark tactical jacket and anti-reflective gloves forcibly accessing cold wallet storage server #04. The suspect matches the physical height (5ft 11in), build, and gait of former senior sysadmin Sameer Verma (ID #SV-992), who was recently terminated for unauthorized database access. At 02:22 AM, the suspect fled the premises in a dark grey sedan (License Plate #DL-09-CB-4491) carrying a reinforced black pelican case.

3. SEIZED PHYSICAL EVIDENCE:
- One 9mm spent brass cartridge casing recovered 1.2 meters from the victim's body (Exhibit B1).
- Discarded synthetic gloves recovered near the rear perimeter fence (Exhibit B2).
- Encrypted server access log file extracted directly from server B4.

4. APPLICABLE LEGAL SECTIONS:
Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) / IPC Sections 302 (Premeditated Murder), 392 (Armed Robbery), and Information Technology Act Section 66D (Cyber Fraud & Data Theft).

POLICE INVESTIGATION & INTERROGATION BRIEF
Case ID: CASE-2026-8891 | Investigating Officer: Inspector Vikram Sharma

1. SUSPECT TRACKING LOG:
Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) cameras located at Cyber Park Expressway Exit 4 captured dark grey sedan (#DL-09-CB-4491) passing at 02:31 AM, traveling towards the western toll plaza. Cell tower triangulation logs for mobile number registered under suspect Sameer Verma (+91 98210-44910) showed active handoffs matching the vehicle trajectory between 02:15 AM and 03:10 AM.

2. WITNESS INTERROGATION - FACILITY GUARD:
Security Guard Ramesh Chand (ID #SG-441) was interrogated at 06:00 AM. Guard Chand stated under sworn oath that at 02:10 AM he observed suspect Sameer Verma bypass the secondary biometric gate using a master override keycard. Guard Chand confirmed suspect Verma had a distinct facial scar across his left cheek and carried a heavy pelican case upon exiting.

3. INVESTIGATIVE SUMMARY & NEXT STEPS:
Physical evidence recovered from suspect residence during search warrant execution includes one Glock-17 9mm pistol (Serial #GL-88392) hidden beneath bedroom floorboards and an encrypted laptop containing wallet backup files. Requesting immediate forensic ballistics matching and DNA profiling.

- Random Match Probability (RMP): 1 in 4.8 billion in the general population.
- Epigenetic analysis confirmed fresh epithelial cell deposition within 18 hours of seizure.
